whoCanSee.title: Who can see my information
whoCanSee.body: Your care team at your health centre and the community health worker who visits you can see your checks and next steps. You see what your care team has shared with you.

whoLooked: Who has looked at my record
whoLookedBody: People who opened your record in this demo, and when.

somethingWrong.title: Something wrong?
somethingWrong.body: If something in your record looks wrong, ask your care team to check it. Your record stays the same until they do.

notice.title: Privacy notice
notice.heading: DEMO NOTICE — NOT APPROVED WORDING
notice.shownBody: Your health check results after your care team has reviewed them, the next steps they agreed with you, reminders you chose, and requests you sent.
notice.whoBody: You, a person legally allowed to act for you, and the care team at your health centre. Everyone who looks at your record is listed in your access history.
notice.storedBody: On this device only in the demo. A real service would store data in Rwanda.
notice.keptBody: To be decided by the Ministry.
notice.choicesBody: You can give or withdraw consent at any time, and ask your care team to correct something that looks wrong.
notice.rightsTitle: Your rights under Rwanda Law No. 058/2021
notice.rightsIntro: The law on the protection of personal data and privacy gives you these rights:

rights.access: Access — see the information held about you.
rights.correction: Correction — ask for wrong information to be corrected.
rights.portability: Portability — receive your information to take elsewhere.
rights.erasure: Erasure — ask for your information to be deleted.

notice.rightNotAvailable: Process to be defined by the Ministry; not available in this demo.

access.title: Who has looked at my record
access.intro: Everyone who opened your record in this demo. Names of staff are not shown — only their role and health centre.
access.empty: No one has looked at your record in this demo yet.
access.filterEmpty: Nothing to show for this filter.

action.result_viewed: Looked at a health check result
